$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007, FLR-ADR-048): FS_renovation 0.1.0, registry/FS_renovation/spec.md. The root applies to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_renovation: the statuses of extension elements, by ID. FS_renovation's data on a core element (its own extensions.FS_renovation) is checked as the object { C: data } against #/$defs/coreElements, which names the seven collections it is defined for - walls, separators, openings, rooms, slabs, roofs and stairs - and no other (spec.md 1.3).
title: FS_renovation 0.1.0
description: A renovation status - existing, demolish or new - for each element of a remodel.

elements.description: 1.3: the status of extension elements, by ID. An extension element has no extensions member of its own (Core 12.5).

coreElements.title: Data on core elements
coreElements.description: 1.3: an element's collection mapped to its FS_renovation data. Only walls, separators, openings, rooms, slabs, roofs and stairs carry FS_renovation data.

status.title: Renovation status
status.description: 2.1: existing - it stands today and stays (the default); demolish - it stands today and is to be removed; new - it is to be built.

element.title: Data on a core element
element.description: 1.3: the extensions.FS_renovation of a wall, separator, opening, room, slab, roof or stair.
